---
name: Skill proposal
about: Suggest a new skill or a focused change to an existing one
title: "[proposal] "
labels: ["proposal"]
---

## Problem

What repeated workflow gap are you trying to solve?

## Why Existing Skills Are Not Enough

List the current skill(s) you checked and why they do not cover the need.

## Proposed Change

- New skill, or
- Update to an existing skill

## Expected Inputs and Outputs

Describe the user task, the decisions the skill should own, and the result it
should produce.

## Risks or Tradeoffs

Call out overlap with existing skills, harness limitations, or portability
concerns.
